title: campelia zanonia var. glabrata
intro: Campelia zanonia var. glabrata, commonly known as the "thorny dragon fruit" or "dragon fruit vine", is a plant species in the family Sapindaceae, native to Southeast Asia. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various ailments, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antipyretic properties, which may help to alleviate fever, reduce inflammation, and protect against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Campelia zanonia var. glabrata include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antimicrobial activity, and display antiproliferative effects against certain cancer cells. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and may contribute to its potential health benefits.
